OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector (e.g. 'PT5M' for 5 minutes).

CROWDSTRIKE_INCIDENTS_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the CrowdStrike API for the tenant's cloud region (e.g. 'https://api.us-2.crowdstrike.com', 'https://api.eu-1.crowdstrike.com').

CROWDSTRIKE_INCIDENTS_CLIENT_ID.description: CrowdStrike API client ID. The API client needs the 'Alerts: Read' scope.

CROWDSTRIKE_INCIDENTS_IMPORT_START_DATE.description: How far back to look on the first import (e.g. 'P7D' for 7 days, 'P30D' for 30 days).

CROWDSTRIKE_INCIDENTS_PRODUCTS.description: Comma-separated list of CrowdStrike alert products to import. Only 'ngsiem' (Next-Gen SIEM) is supported for now; other values are ignored.

CROWDSTRIKE_INCIDENTS_SEVERITY_MIN.description: Minimum severity of the alerts to import: 'informational', 'low', 'medium', 'high' or 'critical'. All alerts are imported when unset.

CROWDSTRIKE_INCIDENTS_INCLUDE_HIDDEN.description: Whether to also import alerts hidden in the Falcon console.

CROWDSTRIKE_INCIDENTS_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking level applied to every created STIX object.
